set.description: Three days of international rugby sevens at The Sevens Stadium, with music and family fun around the pitches. Poland's women's team plays on Fri 27 Nov (Colombia 12:22, Samoa 15:28, Uganda 18:34) and Sat 28 Nov (Mexico 12:22, China 16:47).
